|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3 of [[5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix) (V) (Virtual Block 7)]] (version 4 of 4); it is the current text. The image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1273-1-front-master.png]]), which prints this text. Versions in date order: [[5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix) (V) (Virtual Block 7)]] (original, release sheet of 3 June 2011); [[5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix) (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix) (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); '''this page''' (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix) (V) (Virtual Block 7)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (official text as of 3 June 2011; the surviving copy was re-made 25 July 2011), Dark Side p. 2: “[Pilot] 2. Power +1 while with your leader. If at a Scomp link when opponent draws destiny of: 1-3, you may activate 1 Force; 4-6, you may draw top card of your Reserve Deck; 0 or 7, you may retrieve 1 Force.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of June 3, 2011"; the surviving copy was re-made 25 July 2011), page 2, slip 1 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Dark Side, p. 3). Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 (this page), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=3, page 3. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix) (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “draws a destiny” for “draws destiny” and “activate one force” for “activate 1 Force”, and drops the comma after “0 or 7” (it also writes the pilot icon out as “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots” and uses lower case for “scomp”, “reserve deck” and “force”): “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Power +1 while with your leader. If at a scomp link when opponent draws a destiny of: 1-3, you may activate one force; 4-6, you may draw top card of your reserve deck; 0 or 7 you may retrieve 1 force.”.<ref name="cl-1273_1-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of 14 March and 16 May 2013 carry no game text</ref> The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix) (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-5d6ra7-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix) (V) (Virtual Block 7)]]) again, word for word: “[Pilot] 2. Power +1 while with your leader. If at a Scomp link when opponent draws destiny of: 1-3, you may activate 1 Force; 4-6, you may draw top card of your Reserve Deck; 0 or 7, you may retrieve 1 Force.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual7-Dark card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual7-Dark">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034727/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip.
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 3)<ref name="ml-ds" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix) (V) (Virtual Block 7)]]) again, word for word: “[Pilot] 2. Power +1 while with your leader. If at a Scomp link when opponent draws destiny of: 1-3, you may activate 1 Force; 4-6, you may draw top card of your Reserve Deck; 0 or 7, you may retrieve 1 Force.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1273-1-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip and the PC card image.
